title: GEO_INDICATOR_TEXT_SET
purpose: Blind-skillful generation of directional/indicator typography without sample-image copy

citation_chain.primary_formula_md: HUB_MASTER_FORMULAS_v5.md (E-01 exact strings, E-02 VFX modules, §5 T_diegetic, Axis A contracts)
citation_chain.note: Visual refs lock CONCEPT (directionality/indicator), NOT layout. Blind gen uses catalog+recipe only.

blind_recipe.name: GEO_INDICATOR_BLIND_COMPILE
blind_recipe.principle: Never copy sample image layout. Compile labels from FACE_ANALYSIS_HUB fields only.
inputs: HL.* pixel anchors from clean frame
steps: 1. Load row R from FACE_ANALYSIS_HUB (or TEXT_SET catalog) by method
2. Σ_geo ← {method, 邊界行人, analysis_line(phase), 打擊面=strike_short, 受面=recv_short, force_token, gap_token(phase), n·v, LOOP L-h12}
3. Style(θ) ← PHASE_STYLE[phase] (COLD/CRITICAL/HOT) — materials from HUB E-02
4. For each draw_op: place label/arrow with endpoint ON HL.* anchor (never floating UI)
5. Prefer deterministic SVG/vector bake; secondary diegetic pass must keep exact strings
6. Gate: G-DIR G-LINE G-PHASE G-LOOP G-FAKE (see §0.14.9)
